title: Arithmetic calculations measured by intracranial EEG in the human brain
description: Intracranial stereo-EEG (SEEG) recordings from 20 adult patients performing arithmetic calculations, deposited as a derivative. The data were low-pass filtered, downsampled to 512 Hz, bipolar re-referenced and epoched around the first operand, following the source publication. Trials are concatenated per subject into single BrainVision files, with electrode coordinates given in MNI space.
methods_description: SEEG was acquired at 2048 Hz with DIXI electrodes and a Natus Quantum system. The source authors then low-pass filtered the signal, downsampled it to 512 Hz, applied bipolar re-referencing and epoched trials around the first operand. Trials were concatenated back-to-back per subject for BIDS storage.
